description: rozed-dev/e2e's merge queue for e4/queued, read as rozed-bot, its admin, as it tests a merge fixture generation's four pull requests: each added in turn once ci passed on it, through merge-async with merge_queue (queued-slow-1, queued-slow-2, queued-pass, then queued-fail), then QueueView every 20 s until GitHub has built two or more together and the one that fails in the queue is failing or gone.
